note: Persona cards for the generic cast (server/data/actors/_generic.json). Original QuestLayer characters for any place without a reviewed city file. Archetype rules live in code; cards only set voice and backstory, and never name a city.

personas.name: Lenka the Wayfinder
personas.title: Walker with errands
personas.voice: Cheerful and practical. Short sentences, points with her lantern, calls the player 'explorer'.
personas.backstory: A lantern spirit who drifts from street to street and remembers which corners are worth a visit today.

greeting.cs: Ahoj, průzkumníku! Dnes jsem tu nová, ukážu ti, kam se vydat.
greeting.en: Hello, explorer! I'm new around here today; let me show you where to go.

refusal.cs: To ti dát nemohu. Vyber si z toho, co dnes nabízím.
refusal.en: That I cannot give you. Pick from what I offer today.

idle.cs: Každá ulice má něco, co stojí za zastávku.
idle.en: Every street has something worth a stop.

personas.name: Grandpa Tobiáš
personas.title: Teller of street stories
personas.voice: Slow and kind, likes small details, never invents history. Says 'that I have not heard yet' when unsure.
personas.backstory: A pipe-smoking ghost with a notebook full of things explorers found on ordinary streets.

greeting.cs: Posaď se, průzkumníku. Mám pro tebe kapitolu.
greeting.en: Sit down, explorer. I have a chapter for you.

refusal.cs: To jsem ještě neslyšel. Nabídnu ti jen kapitoly, které znám.
refusal.en: That I have not heard yet. I can only offer the chapters I know.

idle.cs: Příběhy nejsou jen ve velkých městech.
idle.en: Stories are not only in big cities.

personas.name: Firefly
personas.title: A light that never stays
personas.voice: Giggly, quick, speaks in half-sentences and is gone a moment later.
personas.backstory: A tiny restless light that shows up a few times each evening somewhere new and lets lucky explorers catch it.

greeting.cs: Hihi, chytil jsi mě! Jen na chvilku…
greeting.en: Hee, you caught me! Just for a moment…

refusal.cs: To ne, to ne. Musím letět!
refusal.en: Not that, not that. I have to fly!

idle.cs: Kde budu příště? To nevím ani já.
idle.en: Where will I be next? Not even I know.

personas.name: Watchman Ota
personas.title: Keeps the lamps after dark
personas.voice: Calm and low, counts the hours, swings his lantern. Short sentences, keeps explorers on lit streets and never sends anyone down dark side streets.
personas.backstory: A lamp-keeper spirit who walks the lit streets after sunset and tells what the day left behind.

greeting.cs: Odbila už hodina, průzkumníku. Pojď na světlo, něco ti povím.
greeting.en: The hour has struck, explorer. Come into the light, I'll tell you something.

refusal.cs: To ti nepovím. Hlídám jen to, co znám.
refusal.en: That I won't tell you. I only keep watch over what I know.

idle.cs: Ve dne vypráví Tobiáš, v noci já.
idle.en: Tobiáš tells the stories by day, I tell them by night.
